method: mixed: experts (incl. shared) activation-aware MXFP4 with GPTQ error feedback (AA2: re-quantized from BF16, full-row GPTQ, damping 0.01, static floor/ceil scale snap; <256-token experts fall back to plain scales); attention FP8; MTP FP8; PLE n-gram int6 with fp16 group-32 scales; FP8 KV cache with 36 calibrated scales
